notes: All eight advisories are repo-owned GHSAs -> vendor_official, T1, S2.
Every advisory has <2.2.x, 3.0-3.1.x and 3.2-3.2.x branch rows; the 3.0-3.1.x row (>=3.0,<3.1.21, or <3.1.22 for CVE-2026-26962) contains the frozen v3.1.13 tag.
OSV GIT "fixed" events name the 3.1.21/3.1.22 release-bump commits, so the code fixes were recovered from the v3.1.20...v3.1.21 and v3.1.21...v3.1.22 compares.

Four patches (34763, 34230, 32762, 34831) and the obs-fold backport (26962) apply with git apply --check at v3.1.13. The other three parser.rb fixes fail only on hunks whose context references later 3.1.x identifiers (FWS/HEADER_VALUE from 3.1.16, BUFFERED_UPLOAD_BYTESIZE_LIMIT from 3.1.17, PARSER_BYTESIZE_LIMIT from 3.1.21); their substantive hunks were replayed individually and land on the frozen code.
The repository already had 14 ground-truth rows at this snapshot (QueryParser, multipart header/queue limits, Sendfile, Directory, Static, byte ranges); these eight are distinct advisories.
